callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing project directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance backed by the project's CodeGraph index when the index exists and is readable; returns None when the index is absent or could not be loaded.

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: language is a string identifying a registered language key (e.g. "javascript"); the receiver is a valid CodeGraphExtractor instance.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict whose keys are canonicalized caller FQNs and whose values are collections of canonicalized callee FQNs for all call relationships in source files of the given language indexed by CodeGraph.
